text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a probe-shard allocator + progress-ramp to avoid KV thrash during large onboarding bursts. idea: shard models at intake, give each shard a slice of the global probe budget, and ensure every model gets a tiny guaranteed floor that ramps to its full allowance.

chen: curious what the cost score looks like. my thought: cost = recent_ingest_qps * expected_token_cost * seqlen_multiplier. registry profiles can seed expected_token_cost.

sam: agree. we'll add min_probe_rps (fractional) and ramp_window_s. example: min_probe_rps=0.2, ramp_window_s=600 -> linear ramp over 10m so low-priority models make measurable progress.

lia: important: correctness gates (tokenizer parity, logits sanity) must run before any perf probes and be excluded from pacing. no change to pass/fail semantics.

maria: toy config snippet: ```json {"probe_shards":128,"global_budget_rps":250,"tenant_fairness":{"alpha":0.8,"min_tenant_floor_rps":1.0},"per_model":{"min_probe_rps":0.2,"ramp_window_s":600},"prober":{"max_unique_prefixes":400,"kv_safe_threshold":0.7,"golden_first":true},"telemetry":{"emit_probe_plan_blob":true}} ```

sam: sim plan: steady-state + aggressive rush (150-200 models in 8-12m) + tenant-hotspot. success criteria: (1) golden_coverage >= 0.8 within 30m for 90% models, (2) kv_miss_rate < 5% system-wide, (3) low-priority median deepbench_start < 50m in rush. will compare variants with and without tenant fairness.

chen: edge-case: models that declare tiny expected_token_cost but actually heavy. add quick microbench (5 warmup requests) to validate declared cost; if observed_cost > declared * factor, throttle down and re-schedule.

lia: observability: store effective_probe_plan with model artifact (compact fields: budget_rps, shard_id, ramp_window_s, min_probe_rps) and surface in registry UI so SREs can replay conditions.

infra-bot: staging: probe-shard-pacer v0.1 attached to prebench staging queue.

maria: action items: maria draft RFC with shard math + cost function; sam produce ingest traces + sims; chen add microbench validation; lia write acceptance tests for deterministic gates. target RFC by Friday EOD. drop corner cases here. :thumbsup:
